name: VR Boxing Rise to Glory
summary:
Enter the world of professional boxing and fight your way to greatness in VR Boxing Rise to Glory, the ultimate immersive VR boxing experience. Featuring realistic fighters, detailed arenas, physics-based combat, and intense championship battles, this game delivers authentic virtual reality boxing action like never before.

Step into beautifully crafted boxing venues inspired by professional fight arenas and experience every punch, dodge, block, and knockout with realistic movement and responsive controls.
